verdict.line: You lose extended trades and any fight she starts with Test of Spirit before level 10, but once Trinity Force and your Q (Leap Strike) cooldown are online you win the skirmishes that matter.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's damage comes from tentacles she spawns on nearby walls that swing at you and heal her, plus W (Harsh Lesson) on a 4s cooldown that lets her poke constantly without committing — that sustained chip is why Jax sits at a 44% win rate over 955 games with the lane and solo-kill edge going to her. Jax has no tool that out-sustains that early, so the matchup is won by denying her tentacle uptime and her E tether, not by trading evenly in lane.

tell.watch: Whether you're tethered by her E

theirWindow.when: She lands Test of Spirit on you near a wall
theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately. Don't attack her, don't use Q, W, or E near the spirit — Test of Spirit echoes a percentage of the damage the spirit takes back onto you, and any nearby tentacle will swing on it for free while you're stuck fighting.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Harsh Lesson) and Q (Tentacle Smash) are both down
yourWindow.what: Leap Strike (Q) in, Empower (W) your next hit, then Counter Strike (E) to stun once she retaliates. Without her 4s-cooldown leap or wall tentacles to lean on she has no sustain tool to answer the trade.

start.why: 45.4% win rate over 771 games at 62.3% pick — sustains the auto-Q-W trade pattern you want to force rather than letting her dictate poke range.

boots.why: 47.5% win rate over 749 games at 67.3% pick — her damage lands as frequent physical instances (W leap, tentacle swings), and Steelcaps flattens that chip.

core.why: The first real power spike; your Q (Leap Strike) cooldown is already dropping with ranks, and Trinity's damage and mobility close the gap on her sustain window.

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's bonus health and per-interval sustain directly answers a matchup defined by her constant tentacle and W chip damage — Second Wind and Unflinching extend how long you can hold the wave before Trinity Force comes online.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (45.5%) and most picked (76.8%) combo — Ignite punishes the tentacle healing she relies on if you can catch a short-trade window. Flash+Teleport is a close second (44.4%, 17.2% pick) if you'd rather play for side-lane scaling than early skirmishes.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at you and heal her on champion hits — pull trades toward open lane space, not jungle entrances or tower walls.

playing.title: Never fight inside a Test of Spirit tether
playing.detail: Her E (900 range, 16/15/14/13/12s cd) rips your spirit out and echoes a percentage of damage it takes back onto you — don't attack her or use Q/W/E near the spirit, just walk away until it expires.

playing.title: Trade right after her W
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is only a 4s cooldown, so she can poke constantly — watch for the moment right after she's spent it and Leap Strike (Q) in for a free hit before it's back up.

playing.title: Save Counter Strike for her all-in
playing.detail: E (18/16/14/12/10s cd) dodges incoming basic attacks and stuns everything around you afterward — hold it for when she commits rather than burning it on cooldown.

playing.title: Don't dive into tentacle range
playing.detail: If she's forcing a fight near a wall or tower, back off instead of committing — every tentacle swing that lands heals her and tilts the extended trade her way.

playing.title: Track her Leap of Faith cooldown
playing.detail: R is 120/95/70/70/70s and spawns a tentacle per champion hit on top of AoE damage — once she's used it early, you have a long window where her all-in is gone.

playing.title: Hold skirmishes until Trinity Force
playing.detail: Your Q cooldown drops from 17s to as low as 5s at rank 5, so once Trinity Force and boots are online, your reset-based fighting finally outpaces her tentacle sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reading — wall positioning, tether discipline, and cooldown-window timing — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.
